title: Ranked Minigames
description: A way of adding fierceful competition to your favourite minigames
body:
## 🏆 Rank Your Minigames!

Ever wondered who the *truly* best Bedwars player on JartexNetwork is?

**Ranked Minigames** introduces a real-time **Elo ranking system** directly into your game. Forget win streaks—this mod tracks what really matters: winning.

### How It Works
The mod actively tracks your Bedwars matches and adjusts your personal Elo score:
* **WIN a game?** You gain Elo.
* **LOSE a game?** You lose Elo.

This system allows you to finally quantify your skill, climb a competitive ladder, and prove you're the best!

---
## ⚙️ Current Alpha Support

This is an early **Alpha release**. The mod is a work-in-progress, and support is currently limited to:

* **Server:** `JartexNetwork`
* **Minigame:** `Bedwars`

Support for more minigames and servers is planned for future updates!

## 🐞 Bugs & Feedback

As an Alpha, you will likely encounter bugs. Please report any issues or feedback to help development!
